# Feature name

Board task: #N. <!-- Optional: "Verified against <external tool> <version> (<month year>)." when the feature depends on one. -->

One or two paragraphs: what the feature does and why it exists, for someone who has never seen it.

## How it works

The behaviour as it is in the code today, from the user's or the agent's side first, then the mechanics.
Use subsections for separate parts. Tables suit rules, states and mappings.

If part of the feature isn't built, say what's missing here instead of describing a plan.

## Decisions

Choices made for this feature, each with its reason and what it costs. Use a subsection per decision when
it needs more than a bullet:

- **Short name.** What was chosen, and why.

Cross-cutting choices go in `docs/decisions/` instead; link to them from here.
